name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.162: Forced subtitles are never uploaded, and a rewrite keeps the flag.
    A forced subtitle carries only the lines of foreign-language scenes, so it is
    not the film's dialogue and has no counterpart at SubDL. It is now observed and
    never uploaded - the loose-file path skips it before it costs a read or a search
    request, and the embedded path already dropped it.
    The previous version recorded the forced flag on embedded tracks but DROPPED it
    for a loose .srt: the writer had no parameter for it, so a .forced.srt produced a
    row that said nothing. A row that does not state its flags is invisible to every
    reader, so the forced subtitle vanished from the state - and a rewrite of a file
    could turn the gap into the claim "not forced". Both writers now require the flag,
    and a row whose name carries no marker is stated as "no" rather than left silent.
    Finally the language-tag rewrite no longer risks the flag: the forced track is
    re-stated as such and the written file is checked for it, with the original kept
    if it did not survive. Measured against a real file, the additive form is what
    makes this safe - the plain form clears a stream's other flags.
